Base macros, types, and target capability checks for portable low-level C/C++ code.

# Purpose
`fd_util_base.h` defines the base development environment for the codebase and sets the minimum language standard to C17 or C++17. It declares build capability macros such as `FD_HAS_HOSTED`, `FD_HAS_ATOMIC`, `FD_HAS_THREADS`, `FD_HAS_INT128`, and target-specific flags for x86, ARM, SIMD, compression, and sanitizer support, so code can select portable or optimized paths at compile time. The file also provides common primitive type aliases, token and compile-time helper macros, memory and atomic utility wrappers, thread and one-time execution macros, and platform-specific import and timing support. In the codebase, it serves as the central portability and compiler support header that other modules include to share the same assumptions and low-level interfaces.
